simple.meaning: מָעוֹז (mâʻôwz) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a fortified place; figuratively, a defence.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Judges 6:26. The surrounding context includes offering, altar.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מָעוֹז (H4581) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: מָעוֹז (mâʻôwz) / H4581 is traced through Judges 6:26, 2 Samuel 22:33, Nehemiah 8:10, Psalms 27:1 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.full: H4581. maoz or mauz or maoz or mauz מָעוֺז noun masculine Judg 6:26 place or means of safety, protection ( ᵑ0 suffixes as if from עזז , but probably erroneous, compare Buhl Lex 13 Ges § 85k ); — ׳מ absolute 6:26 +, construct Isa 30:2 +; suffix מָעוּזִי 2Sam 22:33 (but read הַמְּאַזְּרֵנִי as || Psa 18:33 ), מָעוּזִּי 31:3 +, מָעֻזִּי Isa 27:5 +, מָעוּזּוֺ Psa 52:9 +, מָעֻזֹּה Dan 11:10 , etc. (read probably מְעוֺזִּי , etc.); plural מָעֻזִּים 11:38 ; 11:39 , suffix מָעֻזְּנֶיהָ Isa 23:11 , read מָעֻזֶּיהָ (Ges § 20o Che Heb.Hpt. and others; strike out dagesh forte in all, see above); — 1 literally place of safety Judg 6:26 , hence (c. collateral idea of strength , as if from עזז = fastness Isa 23:11 , 14 (in 23:14 Che Heb.Hpt. proposes מְחוֺזְכֶם your city ), Ezek 24:25 ; 30:15 ; Dan 11:7 , 10 , 19 , הַמּ ׳הַמִּקְדָּשׁ 11:31 , מָעֻזִּים מִבְצְרֵי 11:39 ; ׳מ הַיָּם i.e. harbour Isa 23:4 , but strike out O1 Du Che Hpt .; ׳מ מֵאוֺיֵב Nahum 3:11 ; compare מ ׳עָרֵי Isa 17:9 . 2. a. figurative, of God ( ׳י ) as refuge Nahum 1:7 ; Psa 27:1 ; 31:5 ; 37:39 ; 52:9 ; Isa 25:4 (twice in verse); Joel 4:16, ׳י וּמְנוּסִי וּמָעֻזִּי עֻזִּי Jer 16:19 , ׳מ מְשִׁיחוֺ יְשׁוּעוֺת Psa 28:8 (|| עָזֿ ); so מ ׳צוּר Isa 17:10 ; Psa 31:3 , מ ׳אֱלֹהֵי 43:2 ; also בְּמָעֻזִּי יַחֲזֵק Isa 27:5 let him lay hold of my refuge (me as refuge); cf . י ׳חֶדְוַת מָעֻזְּכֶם הִיא Neh 8:10 , ׳מ י דֶּרֶךְ ׳לַתֹּם Prov 10:29 . b. of a heathen god , מָעֻזִּים אֱלוֺהַּ Dan 11:38 (read מְחֹזִים cities Che Isa 23:1 ,Heb.Hpt. ). 3 figurative of human protection , ׳מ מַּרְעֹה Isa 30:2-3 ,(both || מִצְרַיִם צֵּל ); מ ׳אֶפְרַיִם ראֹשִׁי Psa 60:9 = 108:9 , i.e. my helmet; also (of angel) Dan 11:1 (|| מַחֲזִיק ). עֲוִיל see II. עול . below
